scope.purpose: Record expert population review of Fe-S plus flavin rows and constrain future use of the proposed v2 flavin.dehydrogenase_oxidase_hydride_transfer sublabel.

headline.side_finding: m_csa:750 may be mislabeled at v1 and should be pulled from current evaluation until reviewed

population_scan.interpretation: Fe-S plus flavin rows are 18 percent of the current v1 flavin bucket, so this is not a one-off caveat. A single hydride-transfer v2 child label would conflate distinct catalytic chemistries.

fe_s_plus_flavin_mechanism_groups.notes: Fe-S is treated as electron relay while the catalytic step is hydride transfer from or to substrate via flavin.
Sequential electron/proton chemistry or coupled dehydration/reduction. Not classical concerted hydride-transfer semantics.
Includes covalent FAD-substrate adduct chemistry and flavin radical dehydratase chemistry.

m_csa:990.v1_rationale: The catalytic locus is the FAD-substrate interface. Two 4Fe-4S clusters relay electrons from ferredoxin to FAD; FAD performs substrate reduction while Asp237 supports dehydration.

m_csa:750.rationale: Mechanism is flavin radical dehydratase chemistry with flavin semiquinone and Fe-S cluster participation, not reductase chemistry in the v1 broad sense.
m_csa:750.test_set_impact: Currently a learned-representation failure canary in the Wave 1 result card; if mislabeled, using it as a canary against flavin_dehydrogenase_reductase is unsafe.

m_csa:123.rationale: FAD is mechanistically central, but the mechanism involves covalent FAD-substrate adduct and sulfur-oxygen bond cleavage rather than classical hydride transfer.

m_csa:497.relationship_to_this_scan: Included in flavin plus metal-ion population; reinforces that cofactor presence alone is not enough to define a flavin hydride-transfer mechanism.

v2_sublabel_decision.reason: The current sublabel groups clean hydride-transfer enzymes, semiquinone/electron-transfer enzymes, covalent FAD-adduct chemistry, flavin radical dehydratase chemistry, and already-flagged NO reductase chemistry.

immediate_fix.description: Keep a broad flavin v1 bucket for statistical power but add a cofactor-complexity and mechanism-class diagnostic axis to evaluation reporting.
diagnostic_axes: mechanism_class: clean_hydride_transfer | electron_transfer_coupled | covalent_fad_adduct | flavin_radical_dehydratase | boundary_or_unresolved

eventual_goal.description: Split into mechanism-typed v2 strata once support is sufficient.
eventual_goal.caveat: Several strata are currently n=1-2 and underpowered.

packet1_implications.m_csa:990: Keep as v1 flavin primary near-orphan row, but carry Fe-S plus flavin and coupled dehydration/reduction metadata.
packet1_implications.m_csa:750: Pull from learned-representation failure canary use until v1 label review.
packet1_implications.m_csa:428: Caveat becomes stronger because one of its apparent primary TM neighbors is m_csa:750, whose v1 label is now contested.

next_actions: Do not use flavin.dehydrogenase_oxidase_hydride_transfer as a ready v2 evaluation child label until expert review splits or annotates heterogeneity.
Add cofactor-complexity and mechanism-class diagnostic axes before reporting flavin v2/within-bucket results.
Pull m_csa:750 from Wave 1 learned-representation failure canaries until v1 label review.
Keep m_csa:990 as v1 flavin_dehydrogenase_reductase with Fe-S plus flavin caveat metadata.
Treat m_csa:428's primary-neighbor evidence as weaker because its primary-hit set includes label-questionable flavin rows.
